fields.name: DataSourceConfig
fields.description: The configuration for the data source used for the evaluation runs. Dictates the schema of the data used in the evaluation.

fields.name: TestingCriteria
fields.description: A list of graders for all eval runs in this group. Graders can reference variables in the data source using double curly braces notation, like `{{item.variable_name}}`. To reference the model's output, use the `sample` namespace (ie, `{{sample.output_text}}`).

fields.name: DataSourceConfig
fields.description: Configuration of data sources used in runs of the evaluation.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the eval was created.
